item.title: 30 Aug: SpaceX is doing in-house casting for blades and vanes, which can accelerate…
item.description: • SpaceX is doing in-house casting for blades and vanes, which can accelerate natural gas turbines coming online by up to eighteen months • Tech backlash reaches fever pitch as AI angst collides with social media fears • California's legislature passes a bill exempting open-source operating systems like Linux from a twenty twenty-five age-verification law • Data center development is driving demand for acoustic consultants • Faro raised a thirty-seven point three million dollar Series B
